facts.value: 301 of the 326 four-session attendees completed the post-survey; 695 treatment respondents completed a post-survey across all attendance levels. Control post-survey completions: 1,034 primary, 318 reading-control, and 828 post-only.
facts.notes: This explains the event report’s 301-deliberator analysis count; 326 is the attendance count, while 301 requires the post-survey.
